data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the same order (Experience, then Baggage allowance, then cabin class) and names cabin class as the parameter; it adds a read-table step and lists the options as Economy, Business or First, which is mostly harmless, though the 'Before you fly' menu label and the tab structure are unverified.
